comment: Read from src/Torus.cpp at commit 71e0bcb, the last commit whose plugin.json carries the installed 2.0.30. Manual-Torus.md says the LFO buttons drop the pitch by eight octaves; Torus.cpp:364 and 367 divide by 1024, which is ten. Both Windings knobs are configured 1 to 6 (lines 190 and 191) but the value is clamped to 5 (lines 338 and 339), so the last fifth of each knob does nothing. The Radius knob is configured -10 to 42 (line 193) while the clamp after the jack is added runs to 45, so the jack can push it past what the knob alone reaches. The output scaling has no final clamp: four detuned copies are each limited to the loudness-compensation figure and then added (lines 456 to 460), so the three outputs can pass 5V by several times when Detune is off centre. The Drive Type switch has no printed label. The panel prints Type, Follow, Radius and PM where the hover texts read Equation, Little Pitch Follow, Radial Difference and FM. The panel-theme submenu is plugin-wide and cosmetic, so it has no line.
